CUSTOM_SSL_CERT_PRIORITY.help: Choose whether to prioritize the certificate from file path or from base64 data. (file | data)
CUSTOM_SSL_CERT_PRIORITY.label: Certificate priority

CUSTOM_SSL_CERT.help: Full path of the certificate or bundle file. It must be readable by the WORKER, which is where the custom-cert job runs since 1.7 moved job execution off the scheduler - not by the scheduler, whatever older documentation says. Under Docker Swarm, mount it on bw-worker and give the path it is mounted at, e.g. /run/secrets/example.com.pem; a Swarm config is fine for a certificate, which is public.
CUSTOM_SSL_CERT.label: Certificate path

CUSTOM_SSL_KEY.help: Full path of the key file. It must be readable by the WORKER, which is where the custom-cert job runs since 1.7 moved job execution off the scheduler - not by the scheduler, whatever older documentation says. Under Docker Swarm, mount the private key on bw-worker as a Swarm SECRET and give the path it is mounted at, e.g. /run/secrets/example.com.key. Never ship a private key as a Swarm config: configs are stored unencrypted in the raft store on every manager node.
CUSTOM_SSL_KEY.label: Key path

CUSTOM_SSL_CERT_DATA.help: Certificate data encoded in base64 or plaintext PEM format.
CUSTOM_SSL_CERT_DATA.label: Certificate data (base64/plaintext)

CUSTOM_SSL_KEY_DATA.help: Key data encoded in base64 or plaintext PEM format.
CUSTOM_SSL_KEY_DATA.label: Key data (base64/plaintext)
